subject: Islanded deployment verification, legal evidence package & rollback authorization
messages:
From: Ben Stuart <ben.stuart@northbridge-ai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@northbridge-ai.com, ops@northbridge-ai.com
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Islanded site - evidence package & rollback sign-off

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start the pre-acceptance run for a small set of islanded (offline) nodes next month. Before we kick that off our security and legal teams want a concrete list of what Redwood will provide for:

- Immutable delivery manifest (chain of custody)
- Signer roster and their PK fingerprints
- A minimal evidence package we can ship with the media for auditors
- A testable rollback authorization flow (DocuSign or equivalent)

Can you confirm what format each artifact will be delivered in, who will sign, and the expected timelines? Also please point us to the acceptance checklist that ops will follow on-site.

Ben
Ops Director
Northbridge AI

Attachments: none

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Stuart <ben.stuart@northbridge-ai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Islanded site - evidence package & rollback sign-off

Ben —

Thanks, this is straightforward. High-level answer up front and then a short plan:

What we will provide:
- Manifest: GZIP of signed manifest (manifest-v3.json) with SHA256 checksums and operator signature timestamps.
- Signer roster: CSV with full names, roles (operator / release lead), and PGP fingerprints (signer_roster_v3.csv).
- Evidence package: copy of the manifest + signed kernel and image blobs packaged into islanded-manifest-v3.tar.gz, plus a PDF summary for auditors.
- Rollback authorization: we can use a DocuSign envelope for operator-level rollback requests; a pre-signed template will be generated (docusign-rollback-authorization.pdf) and tracked in HubSpot.

Plan / timeline:
1) Today: share roster and manifest schema for review (attached).
2) 3/24: Provide signed test manifest and audit PDF for your security team to vet.
3) 3/28: Finalize DocuSign template and get legal OK.

I'll loop in Marissa for the signing process and Priyom for the operator acceptance checklist. If you want, we can do a quick 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the package.

-Vanessa
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signer_roster_v3.csv (csv), manifest-schema-v1.md (md)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Stuart <ben.stuart@northbridge-ai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-23T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Islanded site - evidence package & rollback sign-off

Ben —

Adding the signing roster and our recommended verification steps for on-site engineers. Quick notes:

Signer roster (what you'll get):
- release_lead@redwood.ai, Release Lead, PGP: 0xA1B2C3D4
- field_operator_1@redwood.ai, Operator, PGP: 0xF1E2D3C4
- field_operator_2@redwood.ai, Operator, PGP: 0xB4C3D2E1

Verification checklist for acceptance (brief):
1) Verify SHA256(manifest) matches printed digest on courier manifest.
2) Check PGP signatures on manifest with signer_roster_v3.csv fingerprints.
3) Mount islanded-manifest-v3.tar.gz and confirm signed image filenames and sizes.
4) Run image-signature verification tool (we'll provide a small static binary).
5) Execute a smoke-start with --verify-only mode and capture logs.

We will provide the static verifier, a minimal runbook, and a DocuSign rollback template. If your auditors want binary-level attestations (signed ELF header manifests), we can add those as an optional layer.

-Marissa
Sr. Release Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: islanded-evidence-runbook.pdf (pdf), verifier-linux-amd64 (bin, stub)

From: security@northbridge-ai.com
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Stuart <ben.stuart@northbridge-ai.com>, ops@northbridge-ai.com
Date: 2028-03-24T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Islanded site - evidence package & rollback sign-off

Team,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we approve the evidence package:

- Does the static verifier perform signature validation only, or also check provenance metadata embedded in the tarball? We need both.
- For the signer roster, will Redwood provide signed timestamp assertions (RFC3161) for each signature?
- The rollback DocuSign: can you include a field that records the operator's on-site serial number and a mandatory reason code (audit requirement)?

If you can answer these in the affirmative, we can provisionally approve the format and schedule the acceptance window.

-security@northbridge-ai.com
Security Engineering
Northbridge AI

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: security@northbridge-ai.com, Ben Stuart <ben.stuart@northbridge-ai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-25T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Islanded site - evidence package & rollback sign-off

Hi security team —

Short answers:
- Verifier: does both. It validates PGP signatures and parses provenance metadata in the manifest (build-id, source-repo, builder-id). We'll include a provenance.json inside the tarball.
- Timestamps: yes, we will attach RFC3161 time-stamps for release_lead and operator signatures (signed-timestamps.tar.gz included).
- DocuSign template: we'll add explicit fields for on-site appliance serials and a dropdown reason-code. DocuSign envelope will also include a unique rollback token that maps to a HubSpot event for traceability.

Action items we will complete by 2028-03-28:
- Final signed manifest and signed-timestamps.tar.gz
- docusign-rollback-authorization.pdf (template exported)
- islanded-manifest-v3.tar.gz (evidence package)
- A short video walkthrough for your auditors (~6 min)

Karthik will coordinate a brief acceptance simulation with your ops team the week of 3/29.

--Priyom
Product Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed-timestamps.tar.gz (tgz), draft-docusign-template.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Stuart <ben.stuart@northbridge-ai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, security@northbridge-ai.com
Date: 2028-03-28T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Islanded site - evidence package & rollback sign-off

Vanessa / Priyom / Marissa —

This looks good. We've reviewed the artifacts (manifest, signed timestamps, verifier) with security and ops. Two confirmations before we lock dates:

1) Please provide the final DocuSign envelope ID and the HubSpot event id when you kick the rollback template live.
2) Send the short verifier runbook and the auditor PDF to legal@northbridge-ai.com so our counsel has a copy.

If those are supplied by 3/30 we'll sign off and schedule the 4/04 on-site acceptance window. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Ben
Ops Director, Northbridge AI

Attachments: none
